# Easemob UIKit for React

Primary public entry points:
- `easemob-chat-uikit`
- `easemob-chat-uikit/module`
- `easemob-chat-uikit/component`
- `easemob-chat-uikit/style.css`

Recommended integration docs (start here):
- `README.md`
- `docs/zh/foundation-quickstart.md`
- `docs/zh/integration-modes.md`
- `docs/zh/sdk5-migration.md`
- `docs/zh/business-data.md`
- `docs/zh/faq.md`
- `docs/zh/provider.md`
- `docs/zh/userInfo.md`

English stubs (Chinese is source of truth this wave):
- `docs/en/integration-modes.md`
- `docs/en/sdk5-migration.md`
- `docs/en/provider.md`
- `docs/en/quick_start.md`

Related runtime docs:
- `docs/zh/store.md`
- `docs/zh/troubleshooting.md`
- `docs/zh/Conversation.md`
- `docs/zh/chat.md`

Key runtime files:
- `module/store/Provider.tsx`
- `module/store/rootContext.ts`
- `module/store/index.ts`
- `module/hooks/chat.ts`
- `module/utils/message.ts`

Validation commands:
- `npm run validate:lib`
- `npm run validate:foundation`
- `npm run build`

Notes:
- Use SDK 5 native message fields and managers.
- Avoid internal import paths like `module/store/*` in consumer code.
- Prefer `Provider.providers.userInfo` and `Provider.providers.groupInfo` for business-owned display data.
- Unread clear: `clearConversationUnreadMessageCount` (self only; not peer notify).
- Read receipts: `sendMessageReadReceipts` / `onMessageReadReceipts`; UI status via `sendStatus` + `isPeerRead` / `groupReadCount`.
- Follow-up change: `uikit-public-store-api` for public/internal Store boundary.
